slides.title: Can you understand this Spanish phrase?
Choose your answer
slides.body:
A) Give me the same
B) I don't care
C) I'm equal

slides.title: B — I don't care.
slides.body: It can also mean “either is fine.” Example: ¿Pizza o tacos? Me da igual.

templates.caption:
Stop saying this in Spanish ❌
Send this to someone learning Spanish before they make this mistake.

#learnspanish #spanishmistakes #spanishtips #español #alyaapp

slides.title: Say this instead
slides.body: Use genial, buenísimo, or qué rico depending on the situation.
slides.footer: match the phrase to the context

slides.title: A real example
slides.body: ¿Te gustó la película? — Sí, estuvo genial.
slides.footer: Did you like the movie? It was great.

slides.title: Quick tip
slides.body: Food: está riquísimo. A plan: suena genial. A person: es muy buena persona.
